specificity_observability.description: Feedback references observable behaviors rather than traits or generalities.

anchors.0: No observable behaviors; entirely vague or judgmental.
anchors.1: Mostly vague with minimal behavioral detail.
anchors.2: Some observable behaviors but still general.

competency_alignment.description: Learner digest items are mapped to relevant competencies or marked unmapped.

anchors.0: No competency mapping or incorrect mapping.
anchors.4: All items mapped appropriately or explicitly unmapped.

actionability_feedforward.description: Provides clear, actionable next steps with observable success criteria.

anchors.2: Some actionability but lacks clear success criteria.
anchors.3: Actionable steps with observable success criteria.

tone_psychological_safety.description: Feedback maintains respectful, supportive tone and avoids shaming language.

anchors.1: Harsh or dismissive tone with limited support.

prioritization_impact.description: Prioritizes 1–2 key growth areas rather than a laundry list.

bias_equity_language.description: Avoids biased descriptors and flags potential bias.
